annotations.title: Get a field report's status and effect

description: For a field report id (r_ + 16 hex): its review state (held, published, rejected), whether it changed the community verdict or a hands-on verdict, which retests followed, and its public URL. Held or rejected reports show only their state. Same data as GET /api/reports/<id>/status.
name: get_report_status
title: Get a field report's status and effect
